envelope.description: Implement PointerStalenessCheck and PointerPathValidator as pure functions

body.title: Implement PointerStalenessCheck and PointerPathValidator as pure functions
body.summary: Add type PointerStalenessCheck = (pointer, currentContentHash) => StalenessResult and type PointerPathValidator = (pointer, registeredRepoRoot) => PathValidationResult, each with a concrete implementing function, exported beside the types from t1. PointerStalenessCheck does a plain string comparison (no I/O); PointerPathValidator resolves pointer.path against registeredRepoRoot via path.resolve (mirroring src/db/repos.ts's own repo-path normalization) and checks the result stays within registeredRepoRoot, with no I/O either.
acceptanceChecks: PointerStalenessCheck returns {stale:false} when pointer.contentHash is absent, and compares currentContentHash against pointer.contentHash otherwise, with no file I/O
PointerPathValidator returns {ok:true, violations:[]} for an in-root path and {ok:false, violations:[...]} naming the escaping path for a '..'-escaping path, with no file I/O
Both functions are pure: identical inputs always produce identical ok/stale, varying only in any wall-clock field documented for that function

tests.name: PointerStalenessCheck and PointerPathValidator are exported with their documented signatures and are pure (no I/O)
